status: Matt’s confirmed cam package inclusions, head removal and lifter package, L77 and L76 DOD extras, and fully electric service guide are applied to the private replies. approved.detail: From AUD $423.50 including GST. Engine oil, oil filter and sump plug washer replacement, full vehicle check and report, necessary fluid top ups, tyre pressures including the spare, wheel nut torque, and door, bonnet and boot hinge and latch lubrication where applicable. Report damage and mechanical work needing attention. Extras require a quote and approval. EV and hybrid scope remains model dependent.
From AUD $649 including GST, vehicle dependent. Transmission tuning, unlocking, CPC, fuel pump and other module requirements are priced individually with supporting modifications.

AUD $187 per hour including GST, converted from AUD $170 plus GST, with no minimum labour charge. Diagnostic scans AUD $88 including GST, converted from AUD $80 plus GST. Further investigation and repairs are additional approved work.

From AUD $3,450 + GST, which is AUD $3,795 including GST, drive in drive out, for the listed Holden and Chevrolet LS engines. Includes camshaft, valve springs, locks, retainers, stem seals, heavy duty pushrods, ARP camshaft and crankshaft bolts, timing cover and water pump gaskets, front crank seal, timing chain, coolant, labour and engine ECU dyno tuning. Includes a three bolt camshaft gear where conversion from a single bolt gear is required. Lifters, head removal and other listed optional items are additional. Actual engine, specification and modifications need confirmation.

AUD $1,550 + GST, which is AUD $1,705 including GST, for CNC porting only. Cylinder head removal, additional parts and labour for the head job cost extra. Not a fitted package total. An option across the listed LS combinations.
AUD $750 + GST, which is AUD $825 including GST, for the valve seat upgrade work. Cylinder head removal, additional parts and labour for the head job cost extra. Not an installed total.

approved.detail: Supplied and fitted OTR and tune combinations from AUD $1,500 + GST, which is AUD $1,650 including GST. Vehicle, intake, exhaust, extractors and computer determine the final scope. This is not a supplied exhaust package. Other vehicles need their own quote.

Link to PSI’s coding page and explain the remote dongle option for supported interstate work. Confirm compatibility and exact total. Other makes and features require assessment. Conflicting coding credit examples are not used to calculate prices.

Minimum AUD $100 for servicing and AUD $300 for dyno bookings after date approval. Timely communicated date changes can transfer the deposit with PSI’s agreement. No invented notice cutoff. Standard cancellation retention is qualified by applicable consumer rights and circumstances. Boost does not decide or process refunds.

Generally valid for 7 to 14 days at most, with the written expiry controlling. Expired quotes need review because supplier prices, stock and import exchange rates change. No automatic repricing of accepted work.

Request receipts, part details and inspection paperwork before PSI checks suitability and safety. PSI offers a workmanship warranty. Modified engine and supplier coverage need written scope. No blanket denial of consumer guarantees or automatic rejection of a failure claim.
No loan cars. Towing, pickup and vehicle transport are between the customer and their transport provider. Workshop arrival needs agreement with PSI.

Lifters, head gaskets and bolts, exhaust manifold gaskets, spark plugs, sump gasket and rocker cover gaskets may be extra depending on the job. Lifters require cylinder head removal. CNC porting while the heads are off is optional and separately priced.

Additional AUD $2,000 + GST, which is AUD $2,200 including GST, during a cam job. Includes head removal and refitting labour, genuine MLS head gaskets, LS7 lifters, LS2 lifter buckets and bolts, block cleaning and preparation, and GM head bolts. A parts and labour package, not labour alone. CNC porting, valve seats and other extras remain separate.

Both require head removal and the lifter package for a camshaft upgrade. Matt confirmed DOD work adds AUD $750 + GST to the AUD $2,000 + GST head removal and lifter package. Combined extras are AUD $2,750 + GST, which is AUD $3,025 including GST, above the base cam package. DOD scope includes valley plate replacement, gasket and oil gallery blocking with welch plugs. No complete modified build total is automated.

BEV servicing starts from AUD $325 including GST. No combustion engine, so no engine oil or engine oil filter replacement. This is AUD $98.50 below the AUD $423.50 engine service guide. Exact service scope and additional work need confirmation. Do not apply this price to HEV or PHEV models; hybrids retain a combustion engine and their service price needs model confirmation.

AUD $750 including GST to supply and fit the sump gasket, including parts and labour and blocking off the oil pressure relief valve where fitted. An additional job to the base cam package, distinct from routine sump plug washer replacement. Recorded in the existing LS work context; other vehicles and the actual relief valve need applicability and scope confirmation. GST is already included, not added again.

Lead with the requested base package or service guide. Do not automatically add optional upgrades into a full package total or unsolicited list of extra prices. Retain approved extra prices and fitting conditions for direct price questions or relevant follow ups. Keep known L77/L76 requirements disclosed as separately quoted work; do not describe them as optional or unexpected inspection findings.
